text.ms:
1. Peraturan-Peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2021.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2021

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lapan juta tiga ratus lapan puluh

empat ribu ringgit (RM8,384,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial

Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial

Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2021 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 3,417,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 4,115,000

Perbelanjaan lain 852,000

JUMLAH 8,384,000

Dibuat 3 Jun 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/27/6; PN(PU2)744/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2021.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2021

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding eight million three hundred and eighty-four

thousand ringgit (RM8,384,000) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for the

expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme for the

year 2021 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 3,417,000

Supplies and services 4,115,000

Other expenditures 852,000

TOTAL 8,384,000

Made 3 June 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/27/6; PN(PU2)744/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
